protocol: KeyCLD paper procedure transferred to a planar four-bar, first underactuated experiment

dataset.main_friction: zero; aligned with the conservative paper setting
dataset.renderer: MuJoCo RGB, camera parallel to XZ motion plane, no state markers
dataset.training_labels: RGB sequences and constant actions only; state/physics truth stored separately

model.constraint_form: three constant-distance constraints plus two midpoint coordinates

training.optimizer: official Optax Adam groups, with optimizer state retained between updates
training.loss: unchanged official reconstruction + dynamics + heatmap BCE
training.augmentation: official random 0..7 rotate/flip per frame with heatmap unaugmentation
training.checkpoint_selection: final epoch 40, fixed before testing; no test-guided selection

evaluation.validation_metric: official VPT index, threshold from the original 500 train+validation clips
evaluation.heldout_metric: same VPT function, threshold from training clips only
evaluation.independent_physics: additional metrics; not substituted for paper VPT
evaluation.semantic_caution: Learned keypoints are not guaranteed to coincide with physical hinges; physical interpretation requires a separate check.

recorded_differences: Mechanism topology, rendering geometry, physical parameters and constraint function necessarily change.
Three moving bars require a sufficiently expressive three-point representation; the two-point smoke-test setup is not reused.
Additional untouched test trajectories are added to the paper's 450/50 train/validation split.
Official optimizer update discards its returned state; retaining it repairs Adam implementation to match the stated paper algorithm.
A fixed recorded seed replaces an unrecorded randomly chosen seed.
Logging is local and W&B disabled; numerical libraries use the already deployed compatible versions.
